_meta.purpose: The internal-controls library in CatalogFile shape, so applyCatalogFile creates the Internal Control framework, its 23 category requirements, the pack, and the ICN template->requirement links together.
_meta.why: The 151 ICN-* templates were seeded as global ControlTemplates belonging to no framework and no pack. Their only route into a tenant was a side effect of installing SOME OTHER framework pack, which made installing ISO 27001 create 233 controls instead of 93 (see usecases/framework/install.ts). That sweep was removed, leaving the library seeded and unreachable. This file gives it a framework and a pack of its own, so a tenant installs it deliberately.
_meta.grounding: Codes, titles and categories are taken verbatim from internal-controls.json, which stays the source of truth for control CONTENT (objective, success criteria, testing methodology, related policies) — applyCatalogFile skips field updates on templates that already exist, and prisma/control-template-seed.ts writes those fields. Requirements are the 23 distinct categories the library already carries; nothing is invented here.
_meta.tasksAreEmpty: Deliberate. Authored tasks live on these templates already and are written by prisma/control-template-seed.ts. reconcileTemplateTasks returns early on an empty array, so this file cannot deprecate them.
_meta.crossFrameworkMappings: NOT duplicated here. Each control keeps its policy-mediated ISO 27001 / NIS2 requirement links from internal-controls-policy-framework-map.json; applyCatalogFile upserts links and never deletes, so a control ends up mapped to Internal Control AND to whichever standards its policies reach.
_meta.requirementLayers: TWO layers, deliberately. IC-<DOMAIN> (23) group the library into the domains it already carries. IC-NNN (151) are one-to-one with the controls and are what makes coverage honest: with domains alone, implementing the single cheapest control in each of the 23 domains — 23 of 151, 15.2% of the library — reads as 100% framework coverage, an 84.8-point overstatement. Every template maps to BOTH its domain and its own requirement.

framework.name: Internal Control
framework.description: A deduped library of 151 internal controls imported from a customer GRC export. Organised into 23 operational domains, with one requirement per control so coverage reflects controls implemented rather than domains touched. Cross-mapped to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A and NIS2 Article 21(2) through the policies each control references.

metadata.provenance: Customer GRC export, deduped by control name.
metadata.notAStandard: This is an internal control library, not a published standard. Its requirements are the domains the library itself is organised into; no external clause text is reproduced.
